title: UTAGE 141

agencies.name: Bureau d'Enquêtes et d'Analyses pour la Sécurité de l'Aviation Civile

summary: Union des Transports Africains Flight GIH 141, a Boeing 727-223, took off from Cotonou on 25 December 2003 with overloaded cargo and an unknown center of gravity. During the takeoff roll, the aircraft struck a building containing the localizer 118 meters past the runway end and crashed into the sea, killing 141 people.
probable_cause: The crew attempted to rotate an aircraft that was significantly overloaded (approximately 85.5 tons versus the planned 78 tons) with a forward center of gravity (14% versus the planned 19%), combined with inadequate weight and balance procedures and lack of organizational oversight by the operator.

factors.evidence: The aircraft was overloaded at approximately 85.5 tons with center of gravity at 14%, far forward of the planned 19%, preventing normal takeoff performance (p. 9-10)
The operator possessed neither the material infrastructure nor the skills required to operate a large transport airplane (p. 60)
Passenger boarding and baggage loading took place in conditions of great confusion with no overall supervision or rigor; no document relating to boarding and loading could be supplied (p. 9, 61)
The Guinean civil aviation authority applied ICAO procedures but lacked detailed national regulations and means to inspect compliance (p. 60)
The aircraft struck the localizer building 118 meters past runway end and crashed into the Bight of Benin (p. 9)

events.text: Aircraft landed at Cotonou after departure from Conakry with 86 passengers; 9 disembarked, 63 new passengers checked in, 10 from Togo boarded; airplane at full capacity
Pre-flight checklist began; crew selected flaps 25°, air conditioning shut down
Flight cleared to roll; co-pilot was pilot flying
Takeoff thrust requested and brake release performed; aircraft began acceleration
Speed reached 137 knots; Captain called V1 and Vr; co-pilot applied back pressure on control column with initial minimal effect on aircraft angle of attack
Aircraft struck the localizer building at 13:59:11 UTC on the extended runway centerline, right main landing gear broke off, aircraft banked right and crashed onto beach

recommendations.text: Urgently draw up complete regulations in accordance with ICAO recommended standards and ensure possession of structures and means to enforce these regulations
Ensure that aerodromes check the loading of aircraft and that a copy of the weight and balance sheet is filed with them
Modify certification requirements to ensure presence of on-board systems to determine weight and balance on new commercial aircraft

notes: Read SYNOPSIS, History of Flight, Conclusions (Findings and Causes), and Recommendations sections
Fatality count uncertain due to identification issues; 141 bodies found
Actual weight was approximately 85.5 tons versus planned 78 tons
Center of gravity was 14% versus planned 19%
